_comment: Auto-approval pre-filter rules. The denylist always wins over the allowlist. Always escalated: shell chaining (; && || | ` $() < >), forcing options (--force, -f) and whole-tree arguments (-A, --all, .) that widen a scoped prefix like `git add`. `git -C <dir>` is neutralised before matching (same command, different directory); `git -c <key>=<value>` is not, since it executes code.
